claims.claim_text: The authors say Dr. RTL is a multi-agent framework that automates critical-path analysis, RTL rewriting, and implementation-level evaluation, and improves through reusable optimization skills.
claims.excerpt: We present Dr. RTL, a multi-agent framework that automates critical-path analysis, RTL rewriting, and implementation-level evaluation, while continuously improving through reusable optimization skills.

claims.claim_text: The authors report that, on 20 real-world RTL designs, Dr. RTL achieves average WNS/TNS improvements of 21%/17% and a 6% area reduction over commercial synthesis.
claims.excerpt: Evaluated on 20 real-world RTL designs, Dr.~RTL achieves average WNS/TNS improvements of 21\%/17\% with a 6\% area reduction over commercial synthesis.

claims.claim_text: The paper is listed as an invited paper for ASP-DAC'27.
